model_annotation:
The figure illustrates the changes in two variables over time. 

The x-axis is labeled "Години" (Years) and has a linear scale, with values ranging from 2008 to 2021, marked at intervals of several years (2008, 2012/2013, 2017, and 2021). The y-axis of the left graph is labeled "Средни леглодни (дни)" (Average length of stay in days), with a linear scale and values ranging from 20 to 260, marked at intervals of 20. The y-axis of the right graph is labeled "Структурен ефект върху леглодните" (Structural effect on beds), with a linear scale and values ranging from 1.0 to 2.0, marked at intervals of 0.5.

The left graph shows a red line with a downward trend, starting at approximately 250 in 2008 and decreasing to around 210 in 2021. The right graph also displays a red line, which initially decreases from about 1.6 in 2008 to 1.0 in 2012/2013, then increases to roughly 1.7 in 2017, and finally drops to approximately 1.5 in 2021. Both lines are solid and have data points marked with black dots.
